title: Case Illustrations — The Base Charge for a Return on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Case Illustrations — The Base Charge for a Return on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The base charge for a payment the bank has sent back unpaid on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan rests on what the stretch the return history is read over shows and on how long the plan has been billing.

## The three bands

1. Where two or more payments have been sent back unpaid inside the stretch the return history is read over **and** the plan stands past due at the handling date, the base charge is the term's returned payment fee raised by this desk's repeat-return share. That share is **25 percent**, so the base charge is the fee taken at 125 percent of itself, rounded to the cent.
2. Where no payment has been sent back unpaid inside that stretch **and** the plan has been billing for at least the term's minimum courtesy tenure in whole calendar months, the base charge is the term's returned payment fee reduced by this desk's clean-history share. That share is **40 percent**, so the base charge is the fee taken at 60 percent of itself, rounded to the cent.
3. In every other case the base charge is the term's returned payment fee.

The first band needs both of its conditions: two returns inside the stretch on a plan standing active falls to the third band, as does a single return on a past due plan. The second band likewise needs both: a spotless stretch on a plan that has not yet reached the term's minimum courtesy tenure falls to the third band.

## Figures by term

| Term | Returned payment fee | Minimum courtesy tenure, whole months |
|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 29.00 USD | 3 |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 29.00 USD | 3 |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 29.00 USD | 6 |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 32.00 USD | 6 |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 32.00 USD | 9 |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 35.00 USD | 12 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- *A plan on the 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan, standing past due, with three returns inside the stretch.* Both conditions of the first band hold: 29.00 USD raised by 25 percent is 36.25 USD.
- *A plan on the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan, billing for 8 whole calendar months, with no return inside the stretch.* That term's minimum courtesy tenure is 6 whole months, so the second band holds: 32.00 USD reduced by 40 percent is 19.20 USD.
- *A plan on the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan, billing for 4 whole calendar months, with no return inside the stretch.* The tenure of 6 whole months is not reached, so the base charge is the term's fee of 32.00 USD.
- *A plan on the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan, standing active, with two returns inside the stretch.* The plan does not stand past due, so the base charge is that term's fee of 35.00 USD.
